name: Kazanami no Mikoto
source:
"I see you're looking after my brother. It's good to meet you my name is Kazanami no Mikoto."
A 'god' who serves Kamimusuhi no Kami.
He is a polite and agreeable youth, quite the opposite of his older brother Kuuso.
